name: Luz Saude
note: Portuguese private-hospital group (Hospital da Luz). Fidelidade sold a 40% stake to Macquarie Asset Management (via MEIF 7 MED BIDCO, S.A.) in January 2026 while keeping a controlling position; Fidelidade itself is ~85% Fosun International and 15% state-owned Caixa Geral de Depositos.
